title: Analysis & Probability
description: Measure and integration, functional analysis and measure-theoretic probability, in an order where each course supplies exactly the machinery the next one uses. Begins with one demanding core course and a lighter seminar.

courses.note: Normed and Banach spaces through to the spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators; the measure-theory middle of the course doubles as preparation for MAT-210 and MAT-220.
Read alongside as a seminar; promote to enrolled when the functional analysis course reaches Lebesgue measure.
Introductory optimal transport can begin from probability and optimisation foundations; the deeper PDE and geometric-measure tracks are separate.
